task_intent: Elevate Tessera’s five word games with expressive native controls and matching wall compositions.

mobbin.observed: An uninterrupted crossword grid sits above a focused clue strip with previous and next arrows. The active answer is shaded across the grid.
mobbin.applied: Keep the complete shared grid free of banners; place active-clue navigation immediately below it, with an explicit selected answer and cell.

mobbin.observed: Large legible letters and small corner clue numbers make the crossword readable while the current clue remains directly above the keyboard.
mobbin.applied: Use true-white letters, restrained corner numbering, a clear active clue, whole-answer hardware keyboard entry, and an optional generous single-letter keypad.

primary_web.title: Solve crossword and crossword mini puzzles in News on iPhone
primary_web.applied: Repeat selection switches across/down; previous/next clue controls; smart advancement skips filled squares; checking marks errors; clearing explains shared crossings.

primary_web.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Accessibility
primary_web.applied: 44-point minimum controls, Dynamic Type layout changes, VoiceOver square/clue descriptions, crossed error markers independent of colour, reduced-motion disclosure, and an un-dimmed completed board.

assets: Native geometric grid and production Python RGB render; no third-party reference images are shipped as app assets.
